decision: Single-case ablation contract is complete, with explicit caveats for naive pose/crop/source-render uncertainty and confidence-gate non-support.
findings_text: Direct LAM prior is strong on this source split. Full G117/G110 beats direct and naive. Identity gate is a small positive RGB contributor because removing it lowers PSNR. Confidence weighting is not supported as a positive contributor in this single case because w/o confidence is numerically tied/slightly higher. Source-selected alpha mainly helps mask IoU: fixed alpha keeps PSNR but drops mask IoU below the full variant. The direct/source-gated geometry prior is the dominant factor: replacing it with strict-aware RI3D pseudo geometry collapses back to the old low-IoU result.
naive_baseline_caveat: Naive RI3D failure is not safe to attribute only to pseudo-view image quality. The render manifest shows the same NeRSemble K/R/T adapter and a sign-flip/source-mask plus eval-frustum guard were used, with valid-z/in-frame evidence rather than a catastrophic empty-pose failure (min eval in-frame 0.4821). However, the naive source render already under-covers the source mask (IoU 0.3428303711577204, coverage ratio 0.5265596418494494), so source-space crop/scale/geometry mismatch is present before held-out evaluation. Direct LAM/G110 have much stronger mask support (direct eval IoU 0.8996994861687494; G110 is recorded separately in G113), while the GT pointcloud oracle confirms KRT plumbing is usable but itself under-covers the full alpha mask (oracle eval IoU 0.5236046612111784; G60 mean mask IoU 0.5539237552340944). Conclusion: G110's current value is that it bypasses pseudo-view geometry/pose/crop risk by preserving direct geometry; the naive baseline remains a failed baseline that needs stronger pose/crop/oracle复核 before using it as evidence against pseudo-view supervision quality alone.
next_gate: Replicate the same contract on additional NeRSemble source splits/cases before making a broad method claim.
